summary: Table S4b and Figure S4C report P35 versus P12 across female and male neuronal pools. HypoExplorer estimates the age difference within females, using five pools at each age. The authors’ code defines the matching female coefficient, but the public sources checked contain no gene-level estimates for it. The proposal records this scope difference and leaves concordance unassessed.
openIssues: Reopen if the authors release all_transcripts_res_comp_age_f_neuron.csv, an equivalent labelled result, or a saved fit and annotation from which the female neuronal age coefficient can be extracted.
